## Analysis: Bureau SVG Logo Widget Status on Concertação Website

Based on my investigation, here are my findings:

### **Issue Summary**

The Bureau SVG logo widget is **NOT rendering** on the frontend of either the Portuguese or English versions of the Concertação website, though the infrastructure is in place.

### **What I Found**

#### 1. **Screenshots**
- **Portuguese** (https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/): Header shows navigation menu (Sobre Nós, Atuação, Conhecimento, Cultura, Contato) + language switcher (EN), but **no logo visible in top-left**
- **English** (https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/en/): Same result - navigation only, **no logo visible**

#### 2. **SVG Widget Infrastructure - ACTIVE**
The widget is properly implemented:
- **mu-plugin file exists**: `/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/bit-elementor-svg-widget.php` (9.2 KB, dated 10 Mar 22:08)
- **SVG files exist** at `/wordpress/wp-content/themes/hello-elementor-child/svg/`:
  - `logo-concertacao.svg` (46 KB)
  - `espiral-concertacao.svg` (12 KB)
  - `espiral-do-conhecimento.svg` (36 KB)

#### 3. **Widget Configuration**
The `Bureau_SVG_Widget` class is properly registered:
- Widget name: `bureau_svg`
- Supports: SVG selection, custom CSS classes, custom IDs, linking functionality
- Designed to handle `logo-concertacao` as one of the preset options
- Auto-detects SVGs from child theme `/svg/` directory

#### 4. **Header HTML Analysis**
The accessibility snapshot shows the header structure is:
```
<header> → <container> → <link href="concertacao.bureau-it.com"> [EMPTY - should have logo here] → </link>
```

The logo link container (`elementor-element-9614518`) is **present but empty** - no SVG is being rendered inside it.

#### 5. **Console Errors**
- **Error on English version**: "Unexpected token '&'" (likely a JSON parsing issue in Elementor data)
- **No fatal PHP errors** shown (widget mu-plugin is loading)

### **Root Cause Analysis**

The logo is not rendering because:

1. **Elementor header isn't configured with the Bureau SVG widget** - The header template (Elementor library ID 74155) has a logo link container, but it's not populated with the `bureau_svg` widget instance
2. **Widget is registered but not used** - The mu-plugin registers the widget correctly, but the header template doesn't include it
3. **The error on /en/**: May indicate a data sync issue between Portuguese and English header templates, or corrupted Elementor settings JSON

### **What Should Happen**

According to the widget code (lines 28-40), the logo should:
1. Be selected as `logo-concertacao` in the Elementor widget settings
2. Load the SVG file via `file_get_contents()`
3. Output the SVG inline with color support
4. Optionally wrap it in a link to the homepage

### **Evidence & File Locations**

- **Widget code**: `/Users/dcambria/scripts/server-tools/v2/docker-dev/sites/concertacao/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/bit-elementor-svg-widget.php`
- **Logo SVG**: `/Users/dcambria/scripts/server-tools/v2/docker-dev/sites/concertacao/wordpress/wp-content/themes/hello-elementor-child/svg/logo-concertacao.svg`
- **Shortcode backup**: Theme also has a `[bureau_svg]` shortcode implementation in `functions.php` (lines 355-367) as fallback

### **Next Steps Would Be**

1. Open Elementor header editor and check if `bureau_svg` widget is added to the logo container
2. If missing, add the widget and configure it with `svg_name: logo-concertacao`
3. Enable `link_enabled: yes` to make logo link to homepage
4. Verify the JSON error on English version isn't causing rendering issues

---

**In summary**: The SVG widget is properly installed and functional, but the header template isn't configured to use it. The logo needs to be added to the Elementor header template via the visual editor.

  "content": "# Plano: Corrigir renderização do Logo Concertação no bit-elementor-svg-widget\n\n## Contexto\n\nO widget `bureau_svg` (mu-plugin `bit-elementor-svg-widget.php`) está inserido no header do site concertacao com o SVG `logo-concertacao` selecionado. O SVG IS renderizado no DOM (46KB, presente), mas **completamente invisível** por dois motivos:\n\n### Problema 1 — CSS global conflict (crítico)\nQuando SVGs são inlined em HTML, seus `<style>` blocks se tornam CSS global. O segundo vence na cascata → paths do logo ficam `fill: none` (transparentes).\n\nEvidência:\n```\nCSS rule 1: .cls-1 { fill: currentcolor }  ← logo SVG\nCSS rule 2: .cls-1 { fill: none }          ← outro SVG (vence)\ncomputedFill dos paths: \"none\"              ← resultado\n```\n\n### Problema 2 — SVG sem dimensões (secundário)\nO SVG tem `viewBox=\"0 0 841.89 588.28\"` mas sem `width`/`height` → expande para preencher o container: **1139×796px**. Precisa de controle de tamanho no widget.\n\n---\n\n## Arquivos críticos\n\n- **Modificar**: `wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/bit-elementor-svg-widget.php`\n- **Copiar**: `docker-dev/common/mu-plugins/bit-elementor-svg-widget.php` (cópia canônica)\n- **SVG fonte**: `wordpress/wp-content/themes/hello-elementor-child/svg/logo-concertacao.svg`\n\n---\n\n## Solução\n\n### Fix 1 — Auto-scoping de CSS no `render()`\n\nEm `render()`, após `file_get_contents()`, injetar:\n1. Atributo `data-scope=\"bsvg-{widget_id}\"` no elemento `<svg>`\n2. Prefixar as regras `.cls-*` no `<style>` com `[data-scope=\"bsvg-{widget_id}\"]`\n3. **Preservar** as regras `html[lang]` sem modificação (precisam referenciar o `<html>` global)\n\n```php\n// Após carregar o SVG e antes da injeção de class/id:\n$scope_attr = 'bsvg-' . $this->get_id();\n\n// Injetar data-scope no <svg>\n$svg = preg_replace( '/<svg\\b/', '<svg data-scope=\"' . $scope_attr . '\"', $svg, 1 );\n\n// Scopar CSS interno (apenas regras .cls-*, não as regras html[lang])\n$svg = preg_replace_callback(\n    '/(<style[^>]*>)(.*?)(<\\/style>)/is',\n    function ( $m ) use ( $scope_attr ) {\n        $scoped = preg_replace(\n            '/(?<!\\w)(\\.(?:cls|en|pt)-[\\w-]+)\\s*\\{/',\n            '[data-scope=\"' . $scope_attr . '\"] $1 {',\n            $m[2]\n        );\n        return $m[1] . $scoped . $m[3];\n    },\n    $svg\n);\n```\n\n> Nota: a regex `(?<!\\w)(\\.cls-...)` evita modificar seletores que já têm prefixo.\n\n### Fix 2 — Controle de largura no widget\n\nEm `register_controls()`, adicionar no `content_section` após `svg_name`:\n\n```php\n$this->add_control( 'svg_width', [\n    'label'      => 'Largura',\n    'type'       => \\Elementor\\Controls_Manager::SLIDER,\n    'size_units' => [ 'px', '%', 'vw' ],\n    'range'      => [\n        'px' => [ 'min' => 50, 'max' => 800, 'step' => 10 ],\n        '%'  => [ 'min' => 5,  'max' => 100, 'step' => 5  ],\n    ],\n    'default'    => [ 'unit' => 'px', 'size' => 200 ],\n    'selectors'  => [\n        '{{WRAPPER}} svg' => 'width: {{SIZE}}{{UNIT}}; height: auto;',\n    ],\n] );\n```\n\n---\n\n## Sequência de implementação\n\n1. Ler arquivo atual do widget (`bit-elementor-svg-widget.php`)\n2. Adicionar controle `svg_width` em `register_controls()` (após `svg_name`)\n3. Adicionar bloco de CSS-scoping em `render()` (após `file_get_contents` e antes da injeção de class/id do usuário)\n4. Bump de versão: `1.0.0` → `1.1.0`\n5.    166→    protected function render() {
   167→        $s = $this->get_settings_for_display();
   168→
   169→        $name = ! empty( $s['svg_name'] ) ? $s['svg_name'] : '';
   170→
   171→        if ( empty( $name ) ) return;
   172→
   173→        $file = get_stylesheet_directory() . '/svg/' . $name . '.svg';
   174→
   175→        if ( ! file_exists( $file ) ) return;
   176→
   177→        $svg = file_get_contents( $file );
   178→        if ( empty( $svg ) ) return;
   179→
   180→        // Remover declaração XML (inválida em HTML5 inline)
   181→        $svg = preg_replace( '/<\?xml[^?]*\?>\s*/i', '', $svg );
   182→
   183→        // Injetar class no <svg>
   184→        if ( ! empty( $s['svg_class'] ) ) {
   185→            $class = esc_attr( $s['svg_class'] );
   186→            if ( preg_match( '/\bclass="[^"]*"/', $svg ) ) {
   187→                $svg = preg_replace( '/\bclass="([^"]*)"/', 'class="$1 ' . $class . '"', $svg, 1 );
   188→            } else {
   189→                $svg = preg_replace( '/<svg\b/', '<svg class="' . $class . '"', $svg, 1 );
   190→            }
   191→        }
   192→
   193→        // Injetar id no <svg>
   194→        if ( ! empty( $s['svg_id'] ) ) {
   195→            $id = esc_attr( $s['svg_id'] );
   196→            if ( preg_match( '/\bid="[^"]*"/', $svg ) ) {
   197→                $svg = preg_replace( '/\bid="[^"]*"/', 'id="' . $id . '"', $svg, 1 );
   198→            } else {
   199→                $svg = preg_replace( '/<svg\b/', '<svg id="' . $id . '"', $svg, 1 );
   200→            }
   201→        }
   202→
   203→        // Envolver em <a> se link_enabled = 'yes'
   204→        if ( ! empty( $s['link_enabled'] ) && $s['link_enabled'] === 'yes' ) {
   205→            $href   = ! empty( $s['link_url'] )
   206→                ? esc_url( $s['link_url'] )
   207→                : esc_url( apply_filters( 'wpml_home_url', network_home_url( '/' ) ) );
   208→            $target = ( $s['link_target'] ?? '_self' ) === '_blank'
   209→                ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"'
   210→                : '';
   211→            $svg    = '<a href="' . $href . '"' . $target . '>' . $svg . '</a>';
   212→        }
   213→
   214→        echo $svg; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.OutputNotEscaped
   215→    }

(function() {
  // Find any bureau_svg widget
  var bureauWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-widget_type*="bureau_svg"]');
  
  // Also check if WP Rocket is caching old version
  var metaCache = document.querySelector('meta[name="generator"]');
  
  // Find all data-scope attributes
  var scoped = document.querySelectorAll('[data-scope]');
  
  // Check cls1 rules
  var cls1Rules = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < document.styleSheets.length; i++) {
    try {
      var rules = document.styleSheets[i].cssRules;
      for (var j = 0; j < rules.length; j++) {
        if (rules[j].selectorText && rules[j].selectorText.includes('cls-1')) {
          cls1Rules.push({ selector: rules[j].selectorText, fill: rules[j].style.fill });
        }
      }
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  
  return JSON.stringify({
    bureauWidgetsCount: bureauWidgets.length,
    scopedSVGs: scoped.length,
    scopeValues: Array.from(scoped).map(function(el) { return el.getAttribute('data-scope'); }),
    cls1Rules: cls1Rules,
    generator: metaCache ? metaCache.content : null
  });
})()
